body.x: Exsens participated in “CES(Consumer Electronics Show) 2018 Unveiled” held on January 7, 2018 in Las Vegas, USA to introduce a 3D photo booth which enables the user to make the user’s avatar from photos.

Founded in 2015 and located in Paris, France, Exsens develops and sells 3D photo booths which producee the user’s digital copies in a matter of minutes intended for fitness, health, fashion, video game, entertainment.

With the avatar made in the 3D photo booth, the user can personally produce a character for a video game through monitoring the measurement of the user’s physical sizes, simulating the modification for reality, modifying the shape, and accessorial tests. The digital DNA of the avatar born in such a way is identical to that of the user, and therefore, the avatar can not only see and speak and but also express its feelings. It can even move as if were real.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
